sources.title: ibm-granite/granite-4.2-30b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Granite-4.2-30B supports tool calling with integrated reasoning — the model thinks about which tool to call and why before making the call. Tools are defined using the OpenAI function definition schema.

sources.title: Granite 4.2 brings native reasoning to enterprise agents
sources.snippet: In enterprise workflows, tasks can be ambiguous and involve many steps to complete. An AI model must be able to follow complex instructions, retrieve the correct information, choose the right tools, act in the right sequence, and verify the result. Reasoning helps Granite 4.2 navigate this process more reliably.

sources.title: IBM's Granite 4.2 Models Learn to Think and Act Inside Environments
sources.snippet: IBM has released Granite 4.2, its first family of dense, decoder-only reasoning language models, in three sizes: 3B, 8B, and 30B parameters.
